'''catman421 My Mains and they're Many Toys (MISC) (V1)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[catman421]]
* '''Published:''' 13 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Home One: Docking Bay|DS2-L-homeonedockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Home One: Docking Bay
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Home One Docking Bay catman421 LS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck uses the main characters to beatdown your opponent at docking bays.  Here they get crushed with fallen portals.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

This deck uses Staging Areas to boost force production.  Aim high adds to power and cuts down on opponent's retrieval.  The primary mains are Luke, Leia, Han, and Chewie.  I use the Endor/Death Star II effects to boost the destruction.  I have most of the 'teamwork' cards in the deck.  I have 2 of skywalkers and I Know because of their non-destiny abilities (cancelling imp. barrier or grabbing leia from reserve deck).  I have 5 fallen portals because i want one for every battle.  Unfortunately, it can be played only when my opponent inaitates the battle.  There a 4 signals so i can quickly grab the effects I need.  Sorry About The Mess elimantes a few opponents characters before they become a problem.  In case of a beatdown, I have a houjix (split varient only because of the higher destiny).  Out Of Somewhere allows me to grab another character at the start of a battle (it is very likely that my opponent will have twice my power before battle destiny).  Jedi Presence doubles all rebel's power (everyone except lando and qui-gon).  Sense and Alter provide protection from opponent's interrupts, particularly sense, and effect elimination.  When Luke, Obi, Leia, Han and Chewie are in battle, This deck can produce power 46, 5 weapon fires, with 15 battle destiny (total battle destiny doubled due to im with you too).
